name: The English Village
summary: The English Village is a historic waterfront lifestyle center at the base of London Bridge, featuring boutique shops, dining, and the award-winning Lake Havasu City Visitor Center. Built in 1971 with charming English-themed architecture, this beloved destination offers resort wear, souvenirs, watersports rentals, and stunning channel views.
demographics: The English Village attracts a diverse mix of tourists and local residents, with a strong emphasis on leisure travelers and retirees drawn to Lake Havasu City's waterfront lifestyle. The primary visitor base includes middle to upper-middle income households, typically aged 35-65+, with significant representation from snowbirds and vacation homeowners. The trade area serves both the local Lake Havasu City population and the substantial tourist market visiting the iconic London Bridge, with shopping patterns focused on resort wear, souvenirs, dining experiences, and waterfront activities rather than everyday retail needs.
description: The English Village is a charming waterfront lifestyle center located at the base of the iconic London Bridge in Lake Havasu City, Arizona. Originally built in 1971 by McCulloch Properties as an open-air mall to support the London Bridge's grand rededication, this three-acre destination was designed with storybook-style facades and whimsical English-themed architecture that captured hearts from the very beginning. Over five decades, the Village has evolved from its Hollywood set-like origins into a beloved community landmark, anchored by the award-winning Lake Havasu City Visitor Center and featuring boutique shops offering resort wear, souvenirs, and specialty items. The waterfront location along Bridgewater Channel provides visitors with stunning views of the London Bridge while offering access to watersports rentals, boat tours, and diverse dining options. Today, the English Village continues its legacy as a welcoming destination that honors its historic roots while embracing a bright new chapter of fresh energy and opportunity, maintaining its position as a must-visit attraction for both tourists and locals seeking leisurely strolls, lovely scenery, and unique shopping experiences.
